value.signature: fn approval (& self , act : & ValidatedAct) -> bool

review.body: { let id = act . id () ; id . author == "a" && ((id . family == "Registration" && id . sequence == 1) || (id . family == "Opinion" && id . sequence == 2)) }
review.item_premise: This operation handles the publicly disclosed root or its synthetic verifier premise and records its full public arguments and result.
